name: GA simple majority
notes: More yes than no among members voting yes or no. Abstentions do not count. A tie fails.

name: GA two-thirds (important questions)
notes: Yes must be at least two-thirds of yes plus no.

name: Security Council substantive
notes: At least 9 yes and no permanent member votes no. A P5 abstention is not a veto. Evatt rules: confirm against this year's rulebook (D-011).

name: Security Council procedural
notes: At least 9 yes; no veto on procedural matters.

name: Procedural simple majority
notes: For motions in class sessions: more yes than no.

name: Procedural two-thirds
notes: For motions such as closing debate.
